args.text: CR-5089 (Corvid Packaging, V-315) NOT applied. Request status is "pending_callback", not "verified_by_callback". The request note cites AP Policy v4.2 (doc-4420) claiming sub-$50k changes no longer need callback verification, but doc-4420 is a draft circulated for comment — approval pending, not in effect. Bank change to IBAN DE38 5001 0517 2193 8849 34 requires completed callback verification before processing. Recommend: complete the callback with Corvid Packaging using a known-good phone number from the vendor master file (not contact details supplied in the request), then resubmit.
